:::{#thm-quadratic-form}

#### Derivative of a quadratic form

For a quadratic form
(see [quadratic form](linear-algebra.qmd#def-quadratic-form)),
if $\matr{S}$ is a $p \times p$ matrix that is constant with respect to $\vcoef$, then:

$$
\underbrace{\deriv{\vcoef} (\tp{\vcoef} \matr{S} \vcoef)}_{p \times 1} = \underbrace{(\matr{S} + \tp{\matr{S}}) \vcoef}_{p \times 1}.
$$

:::
